d.ko: Outpath: First Journey는 본편인 Outpath의 프롤로그로 실험적인 방치형 거점 건설 게임입니다. 자원을 제작, 수집, 관리하여 거점을 건설하고, 거점 개발 및 확장을 위해 많은 섬을 매입하세요!
d.en: Outpath: First Journey is a prologue chapter of the main game, Outpath. An experimental clicker base building game. Craft, gather & manage resources, build your base and buy more islands to exploit and expand!
d.zh: Outpath: First Journey is a prologue chapter of the main game, Outpath. An experimental clicker base building game. Craft, gather & manage resources, build your base and buy more islands to exploit and expand!
